// Package sub holds storage.
package sub

// Store persists strings.
type Store interface {
	Put(s string) error
}

// MemStore is an in-memory Store.
type MemStore struct {
	items []string
}

// NewMemStore builds a MemStore.
func NewMemStore() *MemStore { return &MemStore{} }

// Put appends s.
func (m *MemStore) Put(s string) error {
	m.items = append(m.items, s)
	return nil
}
